meta.title: One-Bedroom Villas with Private Pool | King Solomon Kalyves, Crete
meta.description: One-bedroom luxury villas in Kalyves, Crete, with a private pool, rooftop or garden and sea views. Fully furnished and rental-ready. Price list on request.

1-bedroom.title: A private retreat above the sea.
1-bedroom.lead: The most intimate expression of King Solomon.
1-bedroom.text: A generous master bedroom, open-plan living and dining, and a private pool on a garden terrace or a rooftop garden. A personal hideaway for you, and a sought-after premium stay for guests when you are away.
highlights: Private pool on garden or rooftop
Ideal for personal use or premium short stays

meta.title: Two-Bedroom Garden Villas with Pool | King Solomon Kalyves, Crete
meta.description: Two-bedroom garden villas in Kalyves, Crete, with private pool, outdoor kitchen and independent entrance. Turnkey and fully furnished. Price list on request.

2-bedroom.title: Garden living, the pool steps away.
2-bedroom.text: Two-bedroom villas with independent entrances and private gardens that open the living space to the outdoors. Each has its own pool, outdoor kitchen and lounge: the perfect balance of family comfort and Mediterranean ease.

meta.title: Three-Bedroom Rooftop Villas with Pool | King Solomon Kalyves, Crete
meta.description: Three-bedroom rooftop villas in Kalyves, Crete, with private roof garden, pool, outdoor kitchen and panoramic sea views. Fully furnished. Price list on request.

3-bedroom.title: A sky terrace for every evening.
3-bedroom.lead: Where the horizon becomes the main room.
3-bedroom.text: Upper-floor villas with three bedrooms, generous balconies and a private roof garden with pool and outdoor kitchen. Designed for families and for hosting, with the widest views at King Solomon.
highlights: Up to 116 m² of outdoor space

meta.title: Five-Bedroom Luxury Villas on Two Levels | King Solomon Kalyves, Crete
meta.description: The grand villas of King Solomon: five bedrooms on two levels with garden, private pool and sea views in Kalyves, Crete. Golden Visa eligible.

5-bedroom.title: The grand villas, on two levels.
5-bedroom.text: The largest residences at King Solomon. A ground floor with living spaces, kitchen and garden pool, and a complete lower level with additional bedrooms. Room for a large family, generations together, or a premium rental product.

levels.title: Every level of the cliff, mapped.
levels.text: How the 21 villas are arranged across the natural terraces of the site, from the rooftop residences to the garden villas on the cliff edge.
